Wasn't 100% on it ya just left a comment on the devnet-4 specs, that should be omitted <@412614104222531604> I was off yesterday and haven't caught up with the call i think last thing for devnet-4 on the CL side at this point is this: https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/3950 which is part of the execution requests stuff that will also unblock the builder specs so we can do some builder API testing live in devnet-4 yeah don't we need https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/pull/587 also for builder specs? i believe this replaces it: https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/pull/591 I think https://github.com/ethereum/builder-specs/pull/101 is waiting for https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/pull/591 to be merged and then there will need to be a corresponding change here: https://github.com/ethereum/builder-specs/pull/101, but it depends on what the requests stuff ends up looking like <@519796549279023105> could we close [587](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/pull/587) in favor of [591](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/pull/591) ? <@543900561460822016> can we merge 591 in order to unblock 101? done This was my mistake. I thought it was okay to leave out for this release. We will try to follow up with an alpha.8 release after ACD when we decide to pass the hash or not. hopefully we can resolve before next ACD 🙂 could we not discuss this on monday, and make a new release sooner? Sure, that would be fine too! Any CL teams have the builder spec implemented already? We should have mev-rs builder ready very soon for devnet 4 spec. haven't finished implementing alpha 6 and now I see alpha 7 is out too 😂 Was holding off until the spec is stabilized. Will be ready next Tue or Wed
